headline: Product Manager | Growth Strategy and User Experience
summary: Experienced Product Manager with a proven track record of driving user growth and delivering exceptional product experiences. Adept at conducting market research, defining product roadmaps, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to launch successful products. Passionate about leveraging data-driven insights to optimize product performance and achieve business objectives.

bullets: Increased user retention by 15% within six months by implementing a new onboarding process and personalized user journey.
Led the development and launch of a new mobile app, resulting in a 20% increase in app downloads within the first quarter.
Collaborated with engineering and design teams to ensure seamless product integration and a user-friendly interface.
Developed and executed product roadmaps aligned with business objectives, leading to a 10% increase in revenue year-over-year.
Conducted market research and competitive analysis to identify new product opportunities and market trends.
Managed a team of product owners and developers, fostering a collaborative and agile development environment.
Assisted in the development of product specifications and user stories, contributing to the launch of two successful new products.
Conducted user testing and gathered feedback to improve product usability and user satisfaction.
Utilized SQL to analyze user data and identify areas for product optimization.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Telecommunications Engineering
education.detail: Graduated with honors, Dean's List all semesters.
